senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גזז)hewn stone; wall of squared stones.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 1:1">B. Bath. I, 1</cite>, contrad. to <cite ref="C00364"><he>גְּוִיל</he></cite>.
B. Mets. 117ᵇ; a. fr.—לשכת הג׳ the cell of Gazith, name of a Temple compartment, the seat of the Great Sanedrin.
Midd. V, 4; a. fr.—Trnsf. אבן ג׳ (squared stone), a plain interpreter of Bible texts (Midrash).
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 28:9">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXVIII</cite>; 2ᵈ vers. ch. XLVI.
